about: Hedge modelled as a generic product: mulch strip, stems, clipped body with battered sides and rounded top, leafy lumps along both faces and the top. Array it along a line for a run. Geometry drawn for 1.2m_Hedge; the other types share it (sizes in the values). Reference: query: planting hedge planting hospital; images: https://www.google.com/search?tbm=isch&q=planting+hedge+planting+hospital; basis: generic product; brand, model and supplier open for review
